description: Three source tables describe Alberta rental building costs and vacancy. The municipal series distinguishes bachelor and one-, two-, three-bedroom units in non-subsidised buildings with at least three rental units; metadata spans 1987–2021 and lists CSV, XLSX, JSON and XML plus an interface. Two related official-statistic sources explicitly use CMHC Rental Market Survey data for two-bedroom rents and vacancy in Alberta and major urban centres, with populations of 10000 or more. Their sample targets privately initiated structures with at least three rental units and three months on the market. Metadata periods are October 2007–April 2015 for rent and October 2006–April 2015 for vacancy, with CSV and PDF representations. This curator-grouped rental-statistics family preserves different coverage; it does not claim that the municipal table has identical CMHC sampling or values. The separate small-community apartment survey remains a distinct resource. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves the source title, description and original Alberta identifiers. The record labels the material Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs, current file access and numerical contents are unverified. No linked document, workbook, archive, installer or data body was fetched. Specific simulation uses remain unstated unless described above.
